name: Coding room
belongs: Building, fixing, running and deploying software: web apps, dashboards and internal panels, websites and landing pages, browser extensions, mobile app builds and store submissions, scripts and scrapers, databases, APIs, hosting, DNS, security reviews of deployed projects, and dev tools.
not_here: Reading business numbers out of an app with no change to the app, writing proposals or ad campaigns (Mail room). Judging how a design, image or video looks, or generating visuals (Art workshop). Music production software used to make music (Music studio). Cleaning up a personal computer or organising notes (Mail room).
examples: The export on production shows the wrong total, find the cause and fix it
Add a date-range comparison to the metrics dashboard and open a PR
Build a browser extension that sends the video I'm watching to a chat
Check that my private admin panels aren't indexed or open to attackers
